description: This file defines the ProgramTable class within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace, which manages DVB program information, including observers, program data, and NIT PIDs. It provides methods for registering/unregistering observers, querying program data, and managing internal state related to broadcast program tables.

classes.name: ProgramTable
classes.description: Manages DVB program information, observers, and related data within the broadcast namespace.

classes.name: ProgramTable::Observer
classes.description: Inner class that observes MPEG sections related to a specific program table, handling section data.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ProgramTable.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears the internal program data cache.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an observer callback for a specific keyId.

methods.name: Program
methods.description: Checks if a program with given keyId and programId exists and updates the provided pmt reference.

methods.name: NITPid
methods.description: Retrieves the NIT PID associated with a given keyId.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Generates a unique key from keyId and programId.

methods.name: AddProgram
methods.description: Adds or updates a program entry in the internal map.
